## Notes

Pollution stored per 32x32-tile chunk and updated every 64 ticks; chunks at 15 or more diffuse 2% to each cardinal neighbor; tiles absorb per chunk per minute (water 1.536, grass 1.10592); trees damaged above 60; spawners absorb pollution to send attack units (small biter 4); evolution driven by pollution produced.
